tools.name: layout_book
tools.description: Lays out supplied stories, memoirs, letters or recipes as a draft 8.5-inch square book with a page-by-page preview. An existing book ID updates only the supplied fields. The result includes a private editor link for text changes and picture uploads. No images are generated. Nothing is printed or cha

tools.name: list_formats_and_prices
tools.description: Lists hardcover and softcover book formats, prices including shipping, and estimated delivery times for a destination country.

tools.name: create_print_order
tools.description: Creates an unpaid print order and a checkout link for an existing draft book. The delivery address and payment are entered on inkbind.onmax.me through Stripe Checkout. Printing is conditional on payment. This call does not charge anything.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Returns the status and tracking link of a printed book order by its order code (looks like IB-XXXXXXX).
